matches.title: I soloed Hardcore Mode and got Void Splitter. But at what cost?...
matches.snippet: I soloed Hardcore Mode and got Void Splitter. But at what cost?... CHAPTER ONE : Icarus Mentality At day one of the Hardcore Rework, there was a strategy that used Firework Technician to give Minigunners every detection to triumph Solo Hardcore. I tried it out as an attempt to win, since I have a maxed out Skill Tree. I used all of my revive tickets for Wave 45 and and got this as my closest attempt. Okay, I wasn't able to win because micro is difficult to do when you're laggy. (Since I'm on mobile and don't own any other devices currently.) And then a strat with Engineer came out after a rebalance, and I tried it again. People told me I lost due to not microing everything to the back. But due to how my device works (Vivo Y27), it takes three to five seconds to load the sell button. That's for loading the sell button, placing and upgrading the tower takes even longer since each upgrade has its own UI animation that doesn't allow me to spam it like every other Roblox TD game. If only TDS added a toggle to turn them off, so that we can just spam click upgrade to... upgrade... But even with those limitations, I tried it again. And again, but this time with tower skins that have less detail than their default skins. With that, it for EVEN LAGGIER! Proof that it's unoptimized scripts that causesmost of the lag in public matches. Use your default skins if you care about performance.

verified_top_matches.snippet: The Hacker Update Hacker was added, and it's buggy... If you convert a Flying or Ghost enemy, it will not be able to take collsion damage. So with that, you can instakill every enemy in the game with them... Oh yeah, the Void Reaver summons Souls, isn't that nice? Fallen Hacker and its Mission Quest was added. neat. Fallen Mode was rebalanced with a lot of changes. The Heavy and Templar were removed entirely from the Wave Structure. rip. 🥀 The Fallen Dreg takes in Heavy's place, and it's way worse than the Heavy... Why does it not have defense? Still not Farm levels of good, but it's an improvement.
